verdict.rationale: Column is API-first. Its docs expose programmatic control of the core banking surface: accounts, ACH, wires, international wires, FedNow/RTP, checks, book transfers with holds, unified transfer queries and reports. All of it is defined by a published OpenAPI spec (confirmed by probe), and webhooks are explicitly configurable via either the API or the Dashboard. However, no document states full UI/API parity, and some areas are not evidenced as API-accessible: custom roles/permissions, manual KYC review, and statements. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement between the Dashboard and API, API coverage evidence for roles/permissions, manual KYC review and statements, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
